extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) 'island' labels had case and space variants (e.g., 'Torgersen ', 'biscoe') that were normalized to the allowed values; (2) one row (row 15) had an invalid flipper length (-194 mm) outside the allowed range [170, 235] and was excluded; (3) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,700') and was successfully converted to numeric. After fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins was 37.62 mm on Biscoe, 38.77 mm on Dream, and 39.5 mm on Torgersen.
